images.name: 四季历书
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / compositing. Create ONE finished landscape professional GAME UI DESIGN BOARD, number 34, for cozy birdwatching idle game Little Elsewhere. Title exactly "34  四季历书" and smaller "SEASON ALMANAC · Little Elsewhere".
IMAGE 1 IS A LOCKED GAME SCREENSHOT INSERT, NOT A STYLE INSPIRATION. Retain the supplied outdoor painting exactly as the main game viewport: do not repaint, simplify, recolor, add objects, change clouds, rearrange the tree, the birds, window, plants, mug, notebook, water, shoreline, town or mountains. Place the identical existing image into the design board and design UI ON TOP of its margins.
Design board composition: elegant off-white landscape sheet about 16:11. Thin title band at top. The upper ~68% is a large complete 16:9 game viewport using the locked image. The lower ~25% is a clearly separate DESIGN DETAIL STRIP outside the viewport, showing three enlarged interaction states with small arrows. The three panels below are NOT part of the in-game overlay.
Direction: restrained Japanese seasonal almanac, cream paper, faded blue ink, slate text, tiny warm ochre accents, fine drawn weather and moon symbols. Rich functional interaction architecture, NOT only three simple text buttons, NOT a giant decorative HUD. Main idle screen has a slim top-left date/weather chip "11月16日 · 晨曦", a small moon-phase icon, four very compact seasonal tabs "春 夏 秋 冬", top-right tiny 3-hour forecast chips with icons, bottom-left a short bird visitor count and book collection progression "图鉴 12/50", and a slim bottom navigation with original hand-drawn icons and labels "观察 · 来访 · 历书 · 陪伴" plus a discreet seed stock indicator. One compact foldout forecast detail anchored to top right, narrow and not covering central scenery. Normal UI occupies about 8–12% of viewport edges. Tree, central river, skyline and mountains remain open, untouched and dominant.
Lower detail strip, three crisp enlarged state panels: 1) monthly mini calendar with three hand-stamped bird/weather event days, labeled "日历"; 2) selected encounter card showing aurora symbol and short requirements "夜晚 / 晴空", labeled "相遇条件"; 3) seasonal collection with 4 bird thumbnails, two soft silhouettes, a modest progress line and "收录 12/50", labeled "季节图鉴". Clear hierarchy, proper spacing, selected tab, tiny NEW dot, pin/favorite action. These enlarged panels demonstrate a coherent interaction system without stuffing all panels over the main scene.
Use readable short Chinese labels only, no paragraphs of fake text. Fine journal texture only in UI. No ornate frames, no huge title plaque, no wood carvings, no fantasy vines, no glassmorphism, no gradients or glossy plastic, no changing the world painting to match the UI, no software debug toolbar. Polished concept artwork with intentional iconography, functional game interfaces, and quiet Japanese visual rhythm.

images.name: 口袋观察站
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / compositing. Design ONE finished game UI artboard for the cozy idle nature collection game Little Elsewhere. Board title exactly "35  口袋观察站", subtitle "POCKET FIELDKIT · Little Elsewhere".
Input Image 1 is the LOCKED ORIGINAL BACKGROUND IMAGE. Place the unchanged supplied image as the main hero gameplay viewport, and overlay only UI. Do not repaint or pixelize the environment. Do not replace trees, birds, window framing, plants, mug, book, river, shoreline, houses, tower, snowy mountains, or sky. Do not shift their relative proportions. Preserve the reference image's geographic and visual identity.
Professional landscape design-board composition about 16:11: thin header at top; a large complete original game viewport in the upper two thirds; bottom quarter is a clearly separated off-white sheet with THREE enlarged UI interaction states connected with discreet arrows. These detail panels are outside the gameplay image. No giant side dashboard permanently covering the view.
Visual direction: a softly crafted Japanese pixel field kit. UI ONLY uses sharp pixel-grid icons, one-pixel slate/olive outlines, small stepped corners, parchment-cream surfaces, restrained olive green and dusty blue accents, monospaced numerals with legible Chinese text. Texture is a subtle dot-grid notebook paper, not noisy retro CRT. Keep the background painting identical; only the UI is pixel-designed.
Main view must show rich game interaction in 8–12% edge occupancy, not a few blank text buttons. A compact top-left weather/time chip with tiny sun and cloud pixel symbols, top-right visitor count "今日来访 3" and "图鉴 12/50", a contextual tiny pill near one existing tree bird with "NEW" and a five-square familiarity indicator, a compact bottom tool belt: original pixel binocular icon "观察", seed scoop "投喂", notebook "图鉴", sparkle "奇遇", headphone "陪伴". The seed tool is selected with a tiny three-item seed popover above it, only one active popover, with quantity and an add action. Central river, mountains and large tree remain wide open. A small three-square notification queue or visitor-avatar trail is appropriate, no giant popup card.
Separate bottom strip shows three detailed states: left "选择食物" with 3 illustrated seed varieties, one selected and a concise quantity; center "发现来客" with sparrow pixel sprite, a NEW badge, five familiarity squares partly filled, observe and record choices; right "观察档案" with sparrow profile thumbnail, four small known/unknown silhouettes, seen count, one favorite star and a record progress bar. Clear selected state, focus border, hotkey legend on tool belt as tiny hints (1,2,3), coherent design system and intentional distinct pixel iconography.
Text must be crisp and sparse Chinese words, no fake paragraphs. UI should feel complete, playful, tactility of little pixel tools, readable at game scale. No heavy wood frame, no giant decorative book or vines, no excessive ornament, no glassmorphism, no glossy 3D, no rainbow neon, no debug toolbar. Finished professional game interface design illustration, not an implemented app screenshot and not ten random colored buttons.

images.name: 雨声自习室
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / compositing. Create one finished professional landscape UI design board for Little Elsewhere, direction number 36. Exact header text "36  雨声自习室" and small subtitle "LISTENING ROOM · Little Elsewhere".
Input image 1 is the existing original game scenery, a LOCKED IMAGE INSERT. Keep it unchanged within the main viewport: do not redraw, restyle, recolor or change its weather. Specifically keep the original tree, two birds, water, houses, snowy mountains, foreground pots, food tray, mug and book, positions and proportions. This is a UI design only. The rain in the direction name refers to an optional sound choice; DO NOT add rain or nighttime to the backdrop. Place this exact scene as the main image and add refined interface overlays at edges.
Composition: landscape design sheet around16:11 with thin off-white header. Upper ~68% shows the full game view, lower ~25% is a separate cream designer detail strip OUTSIDE the game view with three enlarged UI states joined by slender arrows. The main composition must keep river, town, mountains and birds clearly visible. Main idle HUD around8–12% edge occupancy. No huge permanent side panel.
Direction is calm Japanese study-companion UI merged with a nature collection game. Muted cream paper, blue-grey ink, graphite strokes, tiny amber indicators; small hand-drawn nature icons and gentle tab forms, minimal shadows, subtle paper grain. Rich information hierarchy, not three anonymous plain buttons and not a generic productivity dashboard. Show a compact top-left focus timer card "25:00" with a fine progress ring, small bird symbol and play/pause; nearby very small mode switch "观察 / 专注". Top-right discreet two-line recent visitor notification rail with two bird avatar stamps and timestamps, a small new badge, plus "暂存 2" meaning discoveries kept quietly. Bottom-left small guide tab with collection count "图鉴 12/50", birdfood indicator, and journal action. Bottom-right narrow lofi sound player with tiny waveform, play button, title "窗边电台", volume icon, mixer icon and current sound mini chips. Only one compact active ambient-mixer popover anchored bottom-right, not across the river: three subtle sliders "雨声", "流水", "鸟鸣" with clear handles and mute switches. One scene-linked tiny bird recording dot on an existing bird only.
Three larger UI states below the gameplay viewport: left "专注设置" card with 25 / 5 minute presets, a tiny session progress row, start button and gentle bird motif; center "环境混音" panel with Rain/Water/Birds three small line icons, sliders and one illustrated headphone; right "安静收录" small received-discovery card with bird thumbnail, time, soft NEW badge, "已暂存" status, small star and "稍后查看" action. Demonstrate that rare encounters remain collectable while studying, without popups breaking the peaceful scene. Collection and birdwatching remain recognizably the central game.
Use only concise legible Chinese labels and short numbers, no fake paragraphs. Prefer quiet polished game art UI, tasteful illustration and icon craft, no giant ornament, no vines, no woodcarving, no hyper-real texture, no oily paint, no saturated rainbow or neon, no glassmorphism, no computer debug bar. Preserve original scenery as a screenshot insert, do not reinterpret the outdoors.
